title: rpt section record
description: One section of the report's findings, emitted by rpt sections: the three fixed sections with the headings rpt.yaml gives them, then each custom section required_sections names, in config order.

key.description: description, remediation or poc for a fixed section; the heading for a custom one. Findings' sections are keyed by it.

heading.description: The ## heading finding files use for it.

fixed.description: One of the three fixed sections.

required.description: Every finding must have it, non-empty.
